title: Flatten Nested JSON
hints: Recurse with a prefix string. When you hit a dict, recurse into each key; when you hit a list, recurse into each index.
A scalar (or an empty dict/list) is a leaf: write it to the output under the current prefix.
Build the prefix as `parent + sep + child` only when the parent prefix is non-empty, so top-level keys have no leading separator.
